notes.title: Large Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30372138/ac38bdbabc3072959ac6a0268ea9638344040f33.png[/img]

The game has become free but now has a paid Prime status. Everyone who bought the game earlier will get the prime status for free. Prime status will allow you to have access to the steam inventory, access to separate lobbies with the same players with prime status and profile level. Report malfunctions and bugs by clicking the Report a Bug button in the game. In the near future we will try to fix the shortcomings.

[h1]List of changes
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Interface changes
[*] Level design changes
[*] Improved lighting
[*] Adjusted post effects
[*] Now the PKK has been replaced by an AK 74m for a machine gunner
[*] Now the machine gunner has a silencer on the machine gun at level 5
[*] The laser sight on the shotgun of the medic was replaced with a sight
[*] Improved the laser on the gun
[*] A new sound on the gun
[*] New animation of pistol reloading
[*] New weapon animations
[*] The recoil of all guns has been reduced
[*] The sensitivity of the weapon has been improved
[*] Added customization of all sound and music
[*] Fixed player movement bug
[*] The network code has been rewritten
[*] Improvements to the character's third-person animation
[*] The jacket of the first-person character has been redesigned
[*] Added smoke from weapons
[*] Improved explosions
[*] Added character stun
[*] The staircase system has been redesigned
[*] Replacements for some models
[*] Increased chance of the day
[*] Added the effect of rain and wetting the ground
[*] Added endurance system
[*] Added a fire change system.
[*] Now the whole team will spawn in their place
[*] Added observer mode. Improved models of mines, smoke bombs
[*] Added zoom on multiple sight
[*] Added statistics collection
[*] The steam sdk has been updated.
[*] Added anti-cheat
[*] Change the build system of the game
[*] Added music to the end of the round and the results of the round.
[*] Added music to scene downloads
[*] The settings are balanced. 
[*] Added indicators of sitting and capturing the tower
[/list]
Have a nice game
Best regards, BeyterGamesStudio

notes.title: Future game development
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30372138/da1ad2bd75d45f6ebd6a8d1b2132ad93b75b3c12.png[/img]
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
The game has changed its development studio and is waiting for its biggest update

[b]Further development of the game[/b]
Attention! With the release of the next update, the game will go into shareware access to increase the overall online players in the game. The update will be released within the next month.
[b]Everyone who bought the game before that will be given a Prime account.[/b]
The next step will be to change name the game in Desert Strait: Operation Online in order to avoid a conflict with rights.
A Prime account can be purchased in the future if the game is not purchased from you now.
Advantages of Prime:
[list][*] Access to Steam inventory, weapon skins
[*] The ability to select lobbies with the same Prime accounts (without free accounts on the server)
[*] The system of account levels and the issuance of Steam items
[/list]
[b]The changes will be accompanied by the next update of the game
[/b]List of some changes:[list]
[*] The entire network code has been rewritten
[*] Changing the interface
[*] Rebalancing
[*] Changing the map
[*] Improved animations of weapons and their behavior
[*] Adjusted graphics
[*] Improved game settings
[/list]
When the update is released, there will be a more complete list of changes and additions

[i]Best regards, Beyter Games Studio[/i]

notes.title: What will be in the new update
notes.content:
Soon as we will finish all the key aspects of the update we will update the game to version 11.4385.

[b]New textures on land[/b]
We reworked the textures on the land. Now the game will be more enjoyable in the schedule.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30372138/c4dfda8b74426695f64b67ba6b514692948d087a.jpg[/img]

[b]New settings menu[/b]
Now you can more accurately adjust the drawing distance and save them.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30372138/02b9d2c66017afb8d3bd036a3ec16255cc7d6a16.jpg[/img]

[b]Character body[/b]
We added the body of the character from the first person.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30372138/462f8e4d4abd8df854dfef2f36c6876a1f408515.jpg[/img]

[b]New parallax mapping[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30372138/12a0b2432808170cdc1306496090c29380f22cbf.jpg[/img]

[b]New matchmaking[/b]
In this update we want to apply steam servers.This increases the loading time of the game and reduces the loading when entering the match.

[b]Team update[/b]
New nickname display and statistics. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30372138/7bc761f20a7c6d78005477307035badac92fafd2.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam inventory[/b]
At the moment we are finalizing the inventory. We want to make the player playing in the match received the item "Ammo" and could sell it or collect 5 pieces to exchange for a box in which can drop skins for weapons.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30372138/76e887b676af8c4f33c99b24115b9bc403de7730.jpg[/img]
